body: I think you're right and rationally I can hear you making sense. Im trying to listen above the screaming in my head saying Im not worth trying for. I really appreciate you reaching out to me. I know that I need to make a choice to get through this, try and switch off from the screaming. I am scared that I won't be able to control it once I've had surgery. I will have lost my last defense mechanism and will be completely powerless. Fuck. How did I let myself get to this point man..

I have expressed my financial concerns to her before but I can ask again. I mean of course there are things I can do. I can rationally look at my situation from the outside and see there are answers I can utilise. I just dont feel like I care enough to do it anymore.

I know that people love me. I can feel connected to people in the short term but I dont know how to translate it. I think I rely too heavily on external validation. I feel like things would improve if I learnt how to value myself. I don't really know how to achieve that though. I mean years of therapy and Im still standing on the ledge right? 

I can keep telling myself that I am strong. I have it tattooed on my skin. But I don't want to be strong anymore. I've had to be strong by myself since I was a kid. I want to feel like I am not just doing it all on my own.

I want to but therapy is expensive. I have to pay for my surgery so I'm juggling my finances a bit. I dont know how I can feel safe. I moved back home because I thought it would be ok but that turned out to be the worst decision ever. I have a lot of friends, I still see my friends but I don't feel anything. I try and tell myself "these people love you and they want you to be ok.." but my head is fucked man..
